integrity: Constructive symbolic proof with independent finite literal-product verification; literature comparison assessed only against cited material. No claim of independent mathematical certification.
scientific_limitations: Only finite commutative chain-ring coefficient rings of length at least two and arrow-square-zero quiver algebras. The formula counts ordered pairwise commuting tuples, not irreducible components of a commuting scheme; no extension is claimed to non-chain rings or nonzero length-two paths. Full historical-priority verification remains incomplete.
title: Nested congruence graph formula for commuting tuples in chain-ring quiver algebras
